title: INFORM Risk Index 2024
description: INFORM is a multi-stakeholder forum for developing shared, quantitative analysis relevant to humanitarian crises and disasters. The INFORM Risk Index identifies countries at risk from humanitarian crises and disasters that could overwhelm national response capacity.
